passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.hint: Sign in with a fingerprint, Face ID or PIN, without a password.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.hint: When you sign in with a password, we also ask for a code from an authenticator app.
twoFactor.required: Owners and admins with a password must turn on 2FA: without it you cannot invite or manage members.

setup.passwordHint: To turn on 2FA, enter your account password.
setup.scanHint: In an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or 1Password. If you cannot scan, enter the key below.
setup.codesHint: If you lose your phone, sign in with one of them. Each code works once, and we will not show them again.

codes.title: New backup codes
codes.passwordHint: The old codes stop working. Enter your password to make new ones.

disable.title: Turn off 2FA?
disable.hint: Enter your password to turn off two-factor authentication.
disable.warning: Without 2FA you cannot invite or manage members until you turn it on again.

deletePasskey.title: Delete the passkey?
deletePasskey.text: You will no longer be able to sign in with it.

fresh.title: Sign in again
fresh.text: You can add a key only right after signing in. This protects your account if someone got hold of an old session.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.endOthersText: Every other device is signed out.
